role_evidence.quote: This is an investigational new drug under IND 170975.
we will start with an evaluation of MT-125 as a monotherapy in a first-in-human (FIH) Phase 1 trial with RT in newly diagnosed isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type / MGMT unmethylated GBM

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational dual non-muscle myosin II (IIA/IIB) inhibitor, small molecule
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: simultaneous inhibition of NMIIA and IIB with MT-125 interferes with tumor cell proliferation, invasion and metastasis, while also generating reactive oxygen species (ROS) in tumor cells
arms: MT-125 at MTD and one dose lower than MTD

coder_notes: Temozolomide deliberately not given (MGMT-unmethylated rationale), so it is not listed as an agent. Radiotherapy is given with MT-125, hence regimen combination. PK is plasma only. Expansion cohort randomises two MT-125 doses; no control arm.
